concept: Review and integration: a sustainable personal relationship with obligation and ownership
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across owning outcomes, honoring obligations to dependents, and knowing your limits — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what responsibility means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
